pages.quiz:
MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.
   C. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.

3. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Dance.
   B. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Dance.
   D. Damage equipment used for Dance.

4. Best practice when working on Elements of AND RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   B. Practise Elements of AND RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Elements of AND RESPONDING.

5. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Black, white, and grey

6. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Replace drinking water

7. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the costume
   C. Only the volume
   D. The speed of the music

8. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.

9. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   C. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   D. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. Best practice when working on Singing games: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Singing games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Singing games.
   C. Damage equipment used for Singing games.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Singing games.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm COMPOSING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Elements of AND RESPONDING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. C — Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. B — Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. B — Practise Elements of AND RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. C — Red, blue, and yellow

6. B — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

7. D — The speed of the music

8. A — Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. D — Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. A — Practise Singing games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. (4 marks)

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Melody; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Elements of AND RESPONDING; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
